verifications.claim: The Illinois House of Representatives is the lower chamber of the Illinois General Assembly.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "It has two chambers, the Illinois House of Representatives and the Illinois Senate." (R6); House Members page of ILGA (R1)
verifications.reasoning: R6 describes the bicameral structure with House and Senate as the two chambers; standard legislative convention identifies House as lower chamber.

verifications.claim: The Illinois General Assembly was established in 1818.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The General Assembly was created by the first state constitution adopted in 1818."
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated in R6.

verifications.claim: The Illinois General Assembly meets in Springfield.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The General Assembly meets in the Illinois State Capitol in Springfield, Illinois."
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated in R6.

verifications.claim: The 104th General Assembly consists of 118 members.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "since 1983 the Senate has had 59 members and the House has had 118 members." (R6); "118 members of the Illinois House of Representatives" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: R6 states General Assembly has 59 Senators + 118 House members (177 total); R1 and R7 confirm 118 for House only, not entire General Assembly.

verifications.claim: The 104th General Assembly currently has 78 Democrats.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "Democrats: 78 Republicans: 40" for House (R1); "The Illinois House of Representatives is comprised of 78 Democrats and 40 Republicans" (R7); Senate 59 members (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Numbers apply to House only; General Assembly includes additional 59 Senators with their own partisan breakdown.

verifications.claim: The 104th General Assembly currently has 40 Republicans.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "Democrats: 78 Republicans: 40" for House (R1); "78 Democrats and 40 Republicans" for House (R7); Senate 59 members (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Numbers apply to House only; General Assembly includes additional 59 Senators.
